extension.summary: Organize shortcuts to your favourite content
extension.description: Create and organize Shortcuts (including nested Shortcut subfolders) to your favourite content for quick access.

extension.news:
1.1.2 - Group files stay inside the add-on profile; a malformed JSON group is no longer deleted on read
1.1.1 - Creating a group now refreshes My Groups immediately - Remove Group is on the group context menu (not Edit Group) - Stop forcing a list view (no label sort methods, no default "files" content, programs-only) - Directory listings are not cached, so new groups and shortcuts show up on refresh - Wipe Add-on Data shows a success dialog when it finishes - Tools includes the Settings actions (icon color, context menu, advanced editing, debug logging, backup / restore) - Tools and Settings use the same backup folder
1.1.0 - Fanart re-balanced with a wider left margin so it doesn't compete with the addon browser's overlaid title/description text - Subfolders are now ordered entries within their parent group, alongside regular shortcuts, instead of always being listed separately before them - Shortcuts and subfolders can now be freely reordered relative to each other (previously shortcuts and subfolders could only be reordered within their own separate lists) - New subfolders are appended below existing items by default - Removed the standalone "New Subfolder" menu entry (which also showed up inside home-screen widgets); creating a subfolder is now done via the context menu on any item, matching how everything else is managed - Existing subfolders created by earlier versions are automatically migrated into the new ordering the first time their parent group is opened
1.0.0 - First standalone release of Shortcut Manager, forked from AutoWidget - New, independent add-on ID (plugin.program.shortcutmanager) so this installs cleanly with no pre-existing shortcuts - Shortcuts-only: all Widget functionality and widget caching have been removed - Added support for Shortcut subfolders (nested Shortcut Groups) - New icon, fanart, banner, poster, and clearlogo artwork - Restored a minimal background service solely to keep the "Add to Shortcut Manager Group" context menu setting working (no caching or refresh loop) - Fixed a bug (present since the original AutoWidget) where saving a change while editing a Group's properties would lose track of the edit context on redisplay - Removed remaining dead code (several functions with no callers) and fixed invalid unescaped XML in settings.xml - Provider changed to Bob - Icon now has a fully transparent background; fanart redesigned to match the icon and wordmark
